# Retired Sovereign Engine Contract

The legacy engine is not a current routing, provider, search, or execution
surface. CStar kernel owns durable lifecycle work.

```gherkin
Feature: Retired Sovereign Engine boundary
  Scenario: A caller invokes the compatibility entrypoint
    Given no legacy engine activity is authorized
    When the SovereignEngine compatibility class or main function is invoked
    Then it raises "legacy_sovereign_engine_retired_use_cstar_kernel"
    And no source, state, configuration, process, network, provider, or callback activity starts
```
